name: Tabor
text: My recent stay was wonderful! The host was super responsive. The pool felt like a resort with palm trees, shaded areas, and two different hot tubs. I'm already looking forward to my next visit!

name: Madison
text: Awesome location and walking distance to a lot of great restaurants! The host was helpful and responsive.

name: Julissa
text: Place was exactly how it shows in the description. The area was close to everything and was a nice neighborhood. We loved it!

name: Eric
text: Convenient location. Kitchen had what I needed to cook for myself for a longer stay. Complex is quiet and parking was very close.

name: Scott
text: Great location. Excellent value. Kean Coffee is right across the street — highly recommend.

name: Tish
text: The pool was very nice and great, walkable location.
